revealed.decision_rule: F1: H3a.1 first at alpha 0.05; only if supported, Holm over H3a.2 and H3a.3 at alpha 0.05. F2: H3a.4 at alpha 0.05 regardless of F1, intersection of part a (Holm over 8 tests) and part b (Holm over 4 tests). Every test, raw p and adjusted p is listed in analysis_plan.json tests and families
revealed.failure_criteria: H3a.1 fails: 009's exploratory router gain did not replicate as a preregistered result with this pool and set; 009's 60.7% stays in the record unchanged; M1a stays unmet. H3a.4 fails: no learned router beats rules; ship rules, drop learned controllers (ROADMAP stage 3). A sealed task found in a public file or any overlap in the bound audit: void the set and regenerate before any scoring
hypotheses: H3a.1 (family F1, primary, alpha 0.05): on sealed set 4, greedy, the dev-fitted per-family rules router over the 27-member pool ({'arith_chain': 'quentin-self', 'graph_reach': 'quentin-teacher', 'json_extract': 'quinn-teacher', 'list_transform': 'quinn-teacher'}) beats the dev-chosen best single member (quinn-teacher) by more than 5 points: the one-sided 95% Newcombe method 10 lower bound of the paired difference exceeds 0.05, and the router's all-in compute does not exceed the comparator's
H3a.2 (F1, Holm over 2, tested only if H3a.1 is supported): the full-pool rules router beats the rules router fitted on the nine untrained founders: lower bound above 0

H3a.3 (F1, Holm over 2, only if H3a.1 is supported): at k = 4 samples per task for both arms, the full-pool rules router with self-consistency-4 beats the best single member with self-consistency-4: lower bound above 0, at no more all-in compute

H3a.4 (family F2, alpha 0.05, tested whatever H3a.1 shows; the ROADMAP stage 3 gate as written): (a) at least one of four learned routers (kNN, logistic, Laya zero-shot, Laya fine-tuned) beats rules by more than 2 points (lower bound above 0.02), or is non-inferior to rules within 1 point while its all-in compute is at most 90% of rules; and (b) a Laya router beats kNN or logistic (lower bound above 0); every seed of a seeded router must pass. Failure: no learned router beats rules; ship rules and drop learned controllers

revealed.primary_endpoint: F1: sealed accuracy (checker v3) of A1 minus C0, paired over the scored tasks of sealed set 4, one-sided 95% Newcombe method 10 lower bound against a 5-point margin; F2 (outline endpoint): verified solves per all-in compute of the learned routers against rules

sealed_minimums.rule: after cz sealed-prep the scored file must hold at least these counts; otherwise the set is discarded unread, a new salt is created and the set regenerated with the same command; at most three attempts, each attempt's full sha256, excluded-id sha256 and counts recorded in sealed4_record.json attempts; after three failures the experiment stops before the freeze for an owner decision

task_spec.sealed_generation: cz forge --split sealed --n 3600 with a new salt on the secrets host, then cz sealed-prep against dev 0-479, test 0-799, the EXP-CZ-010 train file, the EXP-CZ-012 practice file and sealed sets 1, 2 and 3 (scored and full files); never read by an agent
task_spec.decoding: greedy, sequential, one llama-server per run, single-adapter serving (no --adapters, no multi-LoRA)
task_spec.per_member_decoding: template and chat_kwargs exactly as in each member's frozen run (models below); thinking off where the frozen run had it off; members without a switch run as frozen
task_spec.runtime: llama.cpp b11539, Vulkan backend, one 16 GB consumer GPU

runner_reproduction.rule: before the freeze the pinned runner reruns two frozen set-2 rows on dev 0-399 with their frozen serving and decoding and --ledger-protocol on, as every sealed row runs: quinn-teacher (EXP-CZ-011, LoRA) and rowan-self (EXP-CZ-010, merged); for each, the sequence of task_issued, attempt and verdict payloads must equal the frozen dev ledger in dev/ exactly, after removing the attempt seed field the flag adds (always 0 for greedy); run_started metadata and run ids differ by design; any difference blocks the freeze

comparator.rule: most dev 0-399 solves; ties: fewer format failures (verdict reason starts with 'format:'), then the member's rank in the pool's dev order (solves, then format failures, then name), then name; the same rule as crates/cz-analyze/src/router.rs fit_router

task_spec.timestamp_rule: the freeze record is pushed to the public research repository; freeze/ROOTS.txt holds four lines, the commitment root, the freeze ledger root, the manifest.json sha256 and the freeze.jsonl sha256; the sealed driver refuses to start unless every line matches the files, the freeze files and manifest are tracked and clean in git, and tools/ots_check.sh verifies freeze/ROOTS.txt.ots: the proof is for this ROOTS.txt and it holds a Bitcoin block header attestation whose merkle root matches the raw block header served by both mempool.space and blockstream.info
